settings.heading: CHOOSE NORDIK RADIANT AND GET THE BEST COMPONENTS FOR YOUR RADIANT FLOOR HEATING SYSTEM

settings.text:
With over 20 years of experience in the field of hydronic floor heating, we have had the opportunity to see almost everything, which has allowed us to refine our practice and to discern the good products from the not so good. Our systems have all the necessary components a quality radiant floor system needs to provide you with unparalleled comfort for many, many years. However, as this is a major investment, it is best to make sure you make an informed choice. You need to be able to determine what a complete and reliable system consists of. Here are some things to consider:

  • Reliability and durability
  • Ease of diagnosis in the event of a problem
  • Ease of maintenance and repair
  • Monitoring features
  • Ease of installation
Here is how our systems differ in the various aspects mentioned above:

settings.heading: Reliability and durability
settings.text: Once installed, our systems require very little intervention on your part. The various components are designed to operate continuously for many years and are covered by extensive warranties.

settings.heading: Easy to diagnosis
settings.text: Displays, thermometers and pressure gauges are integrated at various points in the system to help you understand what is happening in real time. What is the pressure in the system? What is the flow rate in each of your loops? What is the temperature in and out of your loops? These are all questions that your system will allow you to answer and guide you to the source of the problem.

settings.heading: Ease of maintenance and repair
settings.text: In order to allow you to easily service timeworn parts (electrical components, pumps), each component is isolated by valves so that replacement can be made without having to empty the entire system. This reduces the repair time while limiting costs and damage. To ensure that your work is completed quickly, Ecosolaris makes every effort to maintain an inventory of the various replacement components.

settings.heading: Monitoring features
settings.text: We use thermostats that can be remotely controlled and integrated into intelligent energy management systems. This allows you to take advantage of the dynamic pricing offered by Hydro-Quebec, if you wish.

settings.heading: Easy to install
settings.text:
For those who wish to install their system themselves, an installation manual is provided with every purchase.
For those who wish to entrust us with the installation, we offer a pre-assembly service in our workshop, which facilitates their installation and limits any future problems related to a bad installation.
